about_the_game:
Welcome to Easy Bubbles, the ultimate idle aquarium sanctuary where tranquil gameplay meets deep strategic choices. Immerse yourself in a richly detailed underwater realm, meticulously hand-drawn in crisp 2D cartoon style, and discover why Easy Bubbles is more than just an idle game—it’s your personal aquatic retreat.

Discover New Species
In Easy Bubbles, every fish packet you open adds something unexpected to your aquarium. There are seven themed fish packs, each offering any of the 58 species available in the game. You never know whether you’ll unbox a tiny fry or a full-grown beauty—each species appears in two life stages, baby and adult, and in four distinct visual variants: Normal, Colorful, Golden and Rainbow.


To make things even more exciting, every fish is assigned one of seven rarity levels:
Common,Uncommon,Rare,Epic,Legendary,Mythic,Ancient

Expansive Fish Library
58 species to discover
2 life stages per species (baby and adult)
4 visual variants per stage (Normal, Colorful, Golden, Rainbow)

That’s over 406 base designs and more than 3,200 total illustrations to collect and admire.



Real-Time Growth & Strategic Choices
Watch your fish grow from fry into mature adults in real time. You can Manually care for feeding and tank upkeep to speed up growth, or Enable Auto-AFK so your aquarium prospers even when you’re away.

Decide whether to sell fully grown fish for an instant reward or keep them to earn steady passive income. Your timing and choices shape how quickly your underwater empire expands.

Play in the Background While You Work
Keep Easy Bubbles running quietly beside your other tasks. Activate background mode to let your fish continue growing and earning even as you focus on work, study or browsing. With soothing visuals and gentle ambient sounds, your aquarium becomes the perfect desktop companion.

Exclusive Booster Packs
For collectors seeking the rarest specimens, booster packs give you a shortcut to special variants and ultra-rare colorations. Each pack opening is a mini-event—will you land a Common fry or unbox an Ancient Rainbow adult?

Customizable Aquarium Environments
Shape your perfect tank environment with:
-Multiple tank designs and scenic backgrounds
-Adjustable day-night lighting cycles
-Decorative elements such as coral arches, seaweed beds and shipwreck remnants

Relaxing ambient soundtracks or oceanic nature sounds

Personalized Naming & Community Sharing
Assign each fish a name that fits its personality and Share them directly from the game to our community galleries. Exchange tips, admire each other’s tanks and celebrate your unique collections.



Easy Bubbles combines soothing, hands-off gameplay with deep collection mechanics. Whether you’re unwinding after a long day or setting goals to complete your fish library, you’ll find endless delight swimming just beneath the surface. Dive in and start building your dream aquarium today!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1 or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 1.2 GHz (or equivalent AMD)
  • Memory: 2 GB MB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 3000 / AMD Radeon HD 6350 (or equivalent)
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 200 MB free MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible
  • VR Support: None
  • Additional Notes: Keyboard & mouse required 1280×720 minimum display resolution
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit) or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 2.5 GHz (or equivalent AMD)
  • Memory: 4 GB MB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 / NVIDIA GeForce GTX 650 (or equivalent)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB free MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible or onboard audio
  • VR Support: None
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended for faster load times 1920×1080 or higher recommended display resolution

short_description: Easy Bubbles is a relaxing aquarium simulation filled with cute sea creatures. Manage your aquarium with click and idle mechanics, collect resources and have a pleasant experience in the colorful and peaceful underworld.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Arabic, Czech, Danish, Dutch, Finnish, Greek, Indonesian, Japanese, Korean, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Romanian, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Swedish, Thai, Traditional Chinese, Turkish, Vietnamese
